name: app-theme-v2-keyframes-not-keyframes
description: Keyframes text that carries anything other than `@keyframes` blocks — here a bare `body { … }` rule after a valid block — is REFUSED by appThemeSchema: the slot is bounded to what it is for, so the theme principal cannot ship arbitrary same-document CSS through it (ggui#987 §3.4, follower D).

keyframes.light: @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg) } } body { display: none }
